annotations.text:
CHOSEN DIRECTION — Swiss utility
Hairline rules instead of cards, numbered section index, zero rounded corners, black + one red accent, Archivo throughout. Dense and typographic; the tool is a precise instrument, the page is the only soft thing on screen.

THE FIELD FIX
Each section type carries its own fields — School, Degree, Year from, Year to — so structure comes from the form, never from asterisks. Markdown survives only for emphasis inside a sentence. Anything unusual stays free-form under Custom.

NOT CHOSEN — kept for reference.
A: warm editorial paper, serif wordmark, soft cards.
B: dark studio, section tabs, mono metadata.
